title: Rabbi Levi bar Zecharyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:14 and Pesikta Rabbati on “It happened at midnight.” In Bereshit Rabbah 73:5, Rabbi Levi bar Zecharyah says, “Before a woman gives birth, the blame is attached to her; after she gives birth, it is attached to her son.”

notes.text: “Blame” conveys the idiom הסרחון in this saying; the attribution shifts from the mother to her son.
The consulted Shir HaShirim Rabbah and Pesikta Rabbati both name Levi bar Zecharyah. Bereshit Rabbah places the saying about blame in its discussion of Rachel’s words after giving birth.
